summary: Mandatory periodic vehicle exhaust emission test (valid for 6 to 12 months) connected live to national Vahan server.

steps.title: Drive vehicle to authorized PUC station
steps.description: Visit any petrol pump PUC center with vehicle engine in warmed-up running condition.

steps.title: Exhaust gas analyzer probe insertion
steps.description: Operator inserts analyzer probe into exhaust tailpipe to measure CO, Hydrocarbons (HC), and Smoke Opacity.

steps.title: Live webcam vehicle photo capture
steps.description: Webcam captures registration number plate photo while vehicle is connected to testing software.

steps.title: Live upload to central Vahan database
steps.description: Test software uploads emission values directly to central Parivahan server without manual tampering.

steps.title: Collect printed PUC certificate
steps.description: Receive printed certificate containing QR code and validity period (6 months for older BS, 1 year for BS-VI).
